+## What
+Plan.md §4.1–§4.4. Create `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Transcripts/`:

+- `TranscriptLocation.swift` — resolve the recording root from `transcripts.location`: `project` (default) → `<cwd>/.<name>/transcripts/`; `home` → shared root with the `-Users-…` slug scheme; absolute path → as given. +- On first write into a project's transcripts dir, materialize `transcripts/.gitattributes` with `linguist-generated=true` on `transcripts/**` and `merge=union` on `sessions.jsonl` (§4.3). Nothing under `.<name>/` gets ignored. No redaction anywhere (§4.4).
+- `ProjectRegistry.swift` — `~/.config/<name>/projects.jsonl`: append `{path, firstSeen, lastSeen}` when a session starts in a new cwd; paths only, never content; skip stale entries on read (§4.5).
+
+- [ ] Location resolution (project / home / absolute)
+- [ ] Append-only `sessions.jsonl` record shape + rebuild-from-scan
+- [ ] `.gitattributes` materialization
+- [ ] `projects.jsonl` registry append + stale-skip
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Default config resolves the root to `<cwd>/.<name>/transcripts/`
+- [ ] Two appended session records occupy two lines; a torn/corrupt line is skipped on read and the index rebuilds from directories
+- [ ] `.gitattributes` exists with both rules after the first record
+- [ ] An index record round-trips title, updatedAt, and ordered additionalDirectories; no mcpServers field exists
+- [ ] Registry appends once per new cwd and updates lastSeen on revisit
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/TranscriptLocationTests.swift`
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/SessionIndexTests.swift` (incl. corrupt-line and rebuild cases)
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/ProjectRegistryTests.swift`
+- [ ] `swift test` → green
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.

An absolute path is used as given. The resolved root is what `makeSession(recordingRoot:)` receives.
+
+**The on-disk layout, confirmed against Router:**
+- With `recordingRoot` set, a session directory is `<recordingRoot>/<sessionId>/`.
+- **A fork nests inside its parent's directory, and the nesting IS the lineage record.** No file stores a parent path.
+- Identity is the directory name, and it must parse as a ULID.
+- A directory is a session only if it holds `session.json`.
+- `session.json` is write-once.
+- **`transcript.jsonl` fsyncs only after a `.response` event, so the final line can be torn after a crash.** A reader drops a torn final line with a warning. A corrupt earlier line throws. Match that rule in our own readers.
+- `seq` is global across directories, and a merge sorts by `(ts, seq)`.
+
+- `SessionIndex.swift` — `sessions.jsonl`, append-only, one self-contained record per line. +

+- `ProjectRegistry.swift` — `~/.config/<name>/projects.jsonl`. Append `{path, firstSeen, lastSeen}` when a session starts in a new cwd. Paths only, never content. Skip stale entries on read.
+
